useCase: Localizing manipulated regions and creating manipulación probability heatmaps
mechanism: Divides the image into overlapping patches and classifies each independently using a lightweight CNN. Creates a spatial probability map showing manipulación likelihood per region. Aggregates patch-level predictions for an overall assessment. Effective at localizing manipulated regions dentro de an image.
name: Forense Basado en Parches (CNN)
source: Chai et al. (2020) - What Makes Fake Images Detectable? Understanding Properties that Generalize, ECCV
parameters: Patch size: 128x128, Stride: 64, CNN: custom lightweight (4 conv layers), Aggregation: mean + max pooling of patch scores
description: Utiliza CNN classifiers on small image patches para detectar local manipulacións. Each patch is independently classified, creating a manipulación probability map.

references.title: Chai, L. et al. (2020). What Makes Fake Images Detectable? Understanding Properties that Generalize. ECCV.
Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-Generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot...For Now. CVPR.

strengths:
• Provides spatial localization of manipulacións
• Lightweight and fast inference
• Generalizes a través de different manipulación types
• Can detect partial manipulación de imagens
limitations:
• El tamaño pequeño del parche puede pasar por alto inconsistencias globales
• Efectos de borde entre parches
• El rendimiento depende de la diversidad de datos de entrenamiento
• Puede tener dificultades con generación de imagen completa (sin bordes locales)
